_doc: The lines a unit may add to a packet (G-RENDER, test/shiploop_e2e/render_diff.py --unit Un). One key per unit of the efficiency plan, so units that change packet text edit different lines of this file; the list stays empty for a unit that adds no line. An entry: {"prefix": the first characters of the added line (8 or more), "stages": [stage names or patterns, default all], "routes": [inline, ask-agent, default both], and exactly one of "offset": [prefixes of lines the same change removes from the same stage; the entry's added lines may not be longer in all than the removed lines it names] or "approval": the decision that allows the growth (the plan row, owner message or review)}. "note" is free text.
